page.overview:
Who is Jeff Bezos?

Jeff Bezos was one of the plutocrats at the Billionaire Camp retreat for billionaires. He wet himself when he heard a ghost story about a phone call from the Securities and Exchange Commission. A year later, he and Rich Texan declared at the camp that Montgomery Burns was no longer a billionaire.

During Springfield's song and dance performance of "Goodbye, Middle Class", Lisa Simpson pointed out Bart Simpson's naivete over finding a job as easily as Homer Simpson with the lyrics, "He's Jeff Bezos, we're just bozos," while showing Bezos counting money.
